changes.change: with-secrets.json can name aliases files ({"aliases": {"NAME": "secret"}}, kept next to the code that needs them) that also export a secret under the fixed name a tool reads, such as TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID for the Tailscale Terraform provider; an alias of a missing secret is reported and skipped
